description: Every education data domain not shipped with real data in v1.0.0, with the reason and what would unblock it. Mirrors Package001_Geography's acquisition_backlog.json convention: no domain ships guessed or placeholder rows just to appear complete.
environment_blocker_affecting_all_items: This session's organizational egress policy blocked direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial). All v1.0.0 datasets were collected via WebSearch snippets only as a result. A future session with WebFetch access to these domains would allow re-verification at higher confidence and would very likely unblock more of the domains below.

blocked_or_queued_domains.reason: State-wide government school directories run into the tens of thousands of individual schools; per-school verification at the field depth requested (fees, hostel, lab, NAAC-equivalent, lat/long) is not feasible via search-snippet research alone.
blocked_or_queued_domains.unblock_requires: Bulk structured data export (e.g. UDISE+ dataset access) rather than per-institution web research.

blocked_or_queued_domains.reason: Same scale problem as government schools; no authoritative bulk private-school directory was accessible this session.
blocked_or_queued_domains.unblock_requires: UDISE+ or state education department bulk export.
